job.job_description:
Job Description What you ll build
Multi-agent development pipelines that pick up a task, write and review code, spin up preview deployments, capture results, and hand back to humans for approval (we have a live POC - you ll harden and extend it).
Agents that plug into our commerce stack - Magento, Shopify, Node.js services - to automate merchandising, QA, content, and ops.
AI-driven marketing automation across paid, SEO, and lifecycle.
The orchestration and observability that makes agents run reliably at scale - queues, workers, retries, evals, monitoring.
Who you are
You build things nobody asked you to build. Your GitHub, demos, or shipped products speak louder than your r sum .
You get obsessed with hard problems and don t put them down until they work.
You operate with extreme ownership - you take a vague goal and return a working system.
You ship, measure, and iterate fast. You treat shipping as a craft.
You were already building with LLMs and agents before anyone made you - because you wanted to.
You want to build the thing, not just talk about it.
Must-haves
Strong, current coding ability in Python and/or Node.js / TypeScript.
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, etc.) and agent orchestration (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP, or hand-rolled).
At least one real, demonstrable agentic/LLM project you can show and walk through (link required).
Production deployment experience (Vercel, Railway, AWS, or similar) - not just notebooks.
Comfort with the glue: APIs, webhooks, queues, vector DBs, auth.
Strong written and spoken English.
Willing to travel to our Ahmedabad office periodically (flights + stay covered) to build closely with the core team.
Nice to have
eCommerce stack exposure (Magento, Shopify, Hydrogen).
RAG, evals, and agent/prompt observability.
Full-stack / front-end for internal tooling.
Open-source contributions, hackathon wins, or a build-in-public presence.
